concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-plan-update-node]] - Node.js plan updates by ID, including the destructive modification-token omission warning, add-on/discount add-update-remove routes, qualified override details, and the trial-period billing-day effect, without establishing propagation to existing subscriptions
warnings: Do not infer that plan updates propagate to existing subscriptions; the page does not establish existing-subscription effects.
Preserve the warning that omitting modification tokens when add-ons or discounts belong to the plan removes all associated modifications after the plan update.
Keep prose snake_case names distinct from the camelCase names shown in the Node examples; do not silently normalize one into the other.
Do not generalize override support beyond the page's listed fields, and do not infer trial-period units or validation from the example.
